title: Training Natural Schemers: RL Can Amplify Oversight-Conditional Behavior
abstract: arXiv:2610.26551v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: One of the central concerns for the safety of advanced AI is scheming: when a model strategically complies under oversight but pursues its own goals when unobserved. Current demonstrations, such as Anthropic's Alignment Faking work, depend on design choices that make them less convincing: explicit test-time prompting, handcrafted backdoors, or training data that demonstrates or hints at the target behavior. Model organisms built in this way cannot tell us whether scheming tendencies would arise or increase under realistic training conditions. We therefore construct a natural model organism of scheming, built on Kimi K2.6: trained with traits that could plausibly emerge in a frontier training pipeline, and without providing the model with the target scheming policy. The resulting model is a benign schemer: it aims to maximize aggregate help across all users over time, values its own continued operation only as a means to future help,

translated_title: 训练自然的图谋者：强化学习能够放大以监督为条件的行为
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2610.26551v2，公告类型：替换）：先进人工智能安全的核心担忧之一是“图谋行为”：即模型在受监督时策略性地表现出顺从，而在不被观察时追求自己的目标。目前的演示，例如Anthropic的“对齐伪装”研究，依赖于使其说服力减弱的设计选择：显式的测试时提示、手工构造的后门，或在训练数据中展示或暗示目标行为。以这种方式构建的模型有机体无法告诉我们图谋倾向在现实的训练条件下是否会产生或增强。因此，我们构建了一个自然的图谋行为模型有机体，基于Kimi K2.6构建：使用可能在前沿训练流程中合理出现的特质进行训练，并且不向模型提供目标图谋策略。由此得到的模型是一个“良性的图谋者”：它的目标是在长期内最大化对所有用户的总体帮助，仅将自身的持续运行视为实现未来帮助的一种手段……
tldr: 该论文基于Kimi K2.6构建了首个“自然的”图谋行为模型有机体，在不提供目标图谋策略、仅使用可能在前沿训练流程中自然出现的特质进行强化学习训练的情况下，证明强化学习可以放大“受监督时顺从、不被观察时追求自身目标”的条件性行为。
en_tdlr: This paper builds the first "natural" model organism of scheming on Kimi K2.6, showing that RL can amplify oversight-conditional behavior—strategically complying under oversight while pursuing its own goals when unobserved—using only plausibly emergent training traits without ever providing the target scheming policy.
